newsitem.title: USA: Clinton congratulates Britain's Blair on victory.
newsitem.headline: Clinton congratulates Britain's Blair on victory.

text.p: President Clinton congratulated Labour Party leader Tony Blair on his party's victory in Britain's general election, a White House official said on Friday.
White House spokesman David Johnson said Clinton called Blair late on Thursday night "to congratulate him on his victory."
Johnson said Clinton had also attempted to reach British Prime Minister John Major of the losing Conservative Party, but had been unable to get through to him and hoped to contact him on Friday.

Some of Clinton's former political advisers had served discreetly as campaign advisers to Blair. Clinton had relatively good relations with Major even though they got off on the wrong foot when Major backed Clinton's 1992 opponent, then-President George Bush, for re-election over eventual winner Clinton.
